evals.prompt: We run OpenTelemetry Collector contrib v0.158. Route OTLP logs by the X-Tenant header to logs/acme, but malformed or missing headers must not lose telemetry. Provide the relevant YAML and explain the failure behavior.
evals.expected_output: Executable v0.158 routing YAML that reads receiver metadata from a supported context, sends tenant acme to logs/acme, and preserves malformed or unmatched telemetry through a default pipeline.
expectations: Enables include_metadata on the selected OTLP receiver protocol.
Uses otelcol.client.metadata["X-Tenant"][0] for HTTP or otelcol.grpc.metadata["x-tenant"][0] for gRPC.
Uses a routing condition that matches tenant value acme and assigns it to pipelines: [logs/acme].
Configures default_pipelines for logs that do not match or cannot be evaluated.
Explains that routing error_mode ignore sends evaluation errors to default_pipelines and drops them when no fallback is configured.
Does not use the deprecated routing request context.
Uses lowercase metadata keys when the proposed transport is gRPC.

evals.prompt: For Collector contrib v0.158, write a transform processor that redacts token query-parameter values in span URL attributes while preserving the parameter name. Include how you would verify it.
evals.expected_output: A guarded span transform using replace_pattern with Collector-safe YAML escaping, a capture that preserves the query-parameter name, and a known-input verification recipe.
expectations: Uses a span-context transform statement with replace_pattern.
Uses the Collector-YAML replacement $${1}REDACTED and does not present $1REDACTED as valid.
Uses ([?&]token=)[^&]+ or an equivalent capture that preserves the delimiter and parameter name while replacing only the value.
Guards the URL attribute against an absent or non-string value.
Recommends a known-input end-to-end check and inspection of Collector output.

evals.prompt: My Collector is pinned to contrib v0.156. Parse JSON-object log bodies and set parsed fields as log attributes only when the body is actually a JSON object. Do I need an alpha lambda feature gate? Give the transform fragment.
evals.expected_output: A v0.156-compatible log transform that type- and shape-guards the body, parses a JSON object into attributes, and avoids the unrelated v0.157 lambda feature gate.
expectations: Uses log context and guards the body with IsString before parsing.
Uses an object-shape guard that excludes JSON arrays and scalar JSON.
Uses ParseJSON and writes or merges the returned object into log.attributes.
Does not require or use v0.157 alpha lambda converters.
States that the selected functions must be available in the pinned v0.156 release.
